stories.title: Imelda Cajipe Endaya Becomes First Woman Named National Artist of the Philippines
stories.sum: Filipina artist Imelda Cajipe Endaya was named to the Order of National Artists of the Philippines for Visual Arts on September 1, becoming the first woman to receive the honor in its fifty-four-year history.

stories.title: As the Turner Prize Showcase Opens in Middlesbrough, Meet the 2026 Nominees
stories.sum: Featuring work spanning reimagined military medals, metal humanoid figures, the mourning of a mammal and the construction of the M62, the Turner Prize 2026 showcase opens tomorrow.

stories.title: Switzerland’s Fondation Beyeler opens £109.7m expansion
stories.sum: The Basel institution has added three new structures designed by the Swiss architect Peter Zumthor, while also extending its grounds

stories.title: New York Returns 36 Antiquities Worth $5 Million to Syria
stories.sum: On September 23, the office of Manhattan District Attorney Alvin Bragg announced that 36 trafficked or looted antiquities—collectively valued at over $5 million—would be returned to the people of Syria.

stories.title: Court rules Trump can blacklist Anthropic for refusing to enable Claude features
stories.sum: "Overly constrained AI models" could cause military operations to fail, judges say.

stories.title: Sotheby’s is Selling One of the World’s Most Coveted Whisky Bottles
stories.sum: The auction—Sotheby’s first-ever held at the Macallan Estate—also features bottles designed by artists Sir Peter Blake, Valerio Adami, and Michael Dillon.

stories.title: Why Australia chose the world's biggest political stage to reveal OpenAI hack
stories.sum: Australia, which has strict social media restrictions and has proposed controls on algorithms and smart glasses, announced the breach at the UN.
